findings.body: Done-when 11 requires both saved and pinned filtered selections to reopen through the real UI and rerun with the comparison. The supplied functional-check record walks only a saved view; this pinned-report leaf mocks both the pin API and Ask, so it cannot provide the required browser/API/database proof for the pin path. Add the pinned-report reopen to the live functional walk and record that the filtered result and readout are preserved.
findings.title: Not done: functional check

findings.body: Value comparisons are normalized and executed with up to two decimal places, but `formatMoney` rounds to the nearest whole rupee. For example, an applied threshold of `500000.49` is rendered as `₹5,00,000`, while `500000.50` becomes `₹5,00,001`; the saved label, answer readout, and empty-state message therefore describe a different boundary from the one actually queried. Use an Indian-grouped exact-money formatter when paise are non-zero and add a fractional-threshold leaf.
findings.title: Preserve paise in comparison labels
